basis: Both KVM continuations resumed the same original tick-77 camera and input state. Each met the strict native four-tick threshold. The continuation diverged after the first action. Treat restores as repeated stochastic starts at one verified state.

ordinary_vm_reference.start: Game Start, default stock, frozen parent, original Game Over or objective terminal, with no Continue
ordinary_vm_reference.scope: Independent qualification originals. Excluded from the optimizer and the held promotion benchmark.

one_active_anchor.selection: Prospective frozen pre-inference original camera after advancing to a registered Stage 1 tick threshold with at least one spare. Freeze a bounded seed order and one fallback threshold before any of these training-only credits play. Do not select a snapshot retroactively from historical receipts.
one_active_anchor.required_evidence: Source original binary and policy SHA, stationary native trigger tick and X input mask, same-frame pixel hash, actual original state, QMP save and restore wall time, allocated bytes, and physically verified first 60 resumed actions.

pilot_after_qualification.planned_optimizer_updates: One PPO iteration with both input sources equally weighted. Reuse the progress-plus-spares reward and KL cap 0.01.
pilot_after_qualification.cutoff: First confirmed loss or 3000 original ticks from the anchor. Nonterminal fragments keep a bootstrap value from the exact boundary camera.
pilot_after_qualification.anchor_evaluation: Twenty fresh resumes per arm, shared fixed initial state and independent continuation. Require newer-policy death-rate ratio at most 0.75 to release cold-start comparison.
pilot_after_qualification.final_evaluation: Six new held pairs of ordinary Game Starts on the qualified host control, with the evaluation worker isolated from snapshot storage. Require mortality-rate ratio at most 0.75 and no decline in measured early Stage 1 survival. Report Stage 2 arrivals and ending lives and Bomb.
